items.title: 장수말벌 번데기
items.note: 지금: 형태 없는 크림색 덩어리. 실제는 성충 모양이 다 드러나는 흰 번데기 — 겹눈만 먼저 검게 물든다.
items.prompt: Use the first attached image only as the art style reference. Do NOT copy its anatomy. Its subject is deliberately a different creature: copy only the brushwork, outline, lighting and palette, never its shape, pose or composition. The second attached image is a real photo for anatomy reference (front view of the same pupa in a tube): follow its body parts and colours, but draw it in the pose described below, and where it differs from the description, the description wins. Subject: the pupa of the Asian giant hornet (Vespa mandarinia), an exarate wasp pupa that already has the full adult shape: large rounded head with big dark grey-black compound eyes (the only dark part), pale creamy-white waxy body everywhere else, short strong mandibles, the two elbowed antennae laid down along the face and chest, all six legs folded tightly against the underside and clearly visible as separate jointed parts, short wing pads lying along the sides of the thorax, a narrow wasp waist, and a plump segmented abdomen tapering to a point. It is NOT a cocoon, NOT a smooth shell and NOT a blob. Strict side profile, head facing RIGHT, lying slightly curled. Style: detailed painterly naturalist illustration with a soft dark outline, matching the attached style image. Single isolated subject, plain flat pale sage-green background touching the outline directly, no ground, no ground line, no tube, no cell, no cocoon, no shadow, no glow, no text, no watermark. Square 1:1.
